title: Tue 03 Nov 2026: Wall Street splits as oil tumbles, Bank of England decision live on Thursday, transaction reporting deadline looms
summary: The Dow rises while the Nasdaq slides, and oil has its sharpest fall in three months on US-Iran diplomacy hopes. We preview a genuinely live Bank of England decision on Thursday, look at the FCA's transaction reporting and crypto consultations and the pending alternative fund manager regime, and examine industry consolidation. Three COO action points and the diary for the week.
